what: Procter & Gamble makes everyday household brands: Tide, Pampers, Gillette, Head & Shoulders, Oral-B, Ariel, Pantene, Charmin and many more.
customers: Supermarkets, pharmacies and online retailers that sell to billions of consumers in about 180 countries.
moat: Leading brands in essentials, large R&D and marketing budgets, and scale with retailers.
